items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: You mean with her brother Sam?

ctx.x: so I went over to his house after I got all straightened out, got located, and dressed all up and went over to his home. And Marge was on the floor shooting dice with the boys.
You mean with her brother Sam?
Yeah, because they'd had rehearsal that day. I think I told you this before.
